content.title: Japan Is The 'Anti-Bubble': WisdomTree' Schwartz
content.description: Last week Japan's governing coalition abruptly collapsed in a major blow to new ruling party leader Sanae Takaichi, plunging the country into one of its biggest political crises in decades and jolting markets. Jeremy Schwartz, global CIO at WisdomTree, speaks with Katie Greifeld and Scarlet Fu on "Bloomberg ETF IQ". They discuss his WisdomTree Japan Hedged Equity ETF (ticker: DXJ), the yen, the new political leadership in Japan and the US dollar.
